limits: Agent-tested only. Bots are not players: fun, fairness, pacing and whether the drops read as spectacle are player verdicts.
Black no-refill is marginal in Acts II and III; Red is untouched by the bot.
Seven Crane door crossings fail in the lab on the published v0.38.0 as well; their real-input behaviour is therefore unproven here, not worse.
Crown reinforcement was checked by variable trace; its 1-HP lab crew sometimes never dies, baseline included.
Backup spawn count is the native spawner roll inside a 30-frame window: one or two Maws.
Act II arrives at two thirds rather than half health because the published marker word was patched.
The room ramp was not retuned; no hardware run.
